auto_memory.rationale: Locked decision. Pointing autoMemoryDirectory at a checked-in folder means Claude commits unreviewed notes to the repo. Shared knowledge belongs in version-controlled CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/.

notes: Only the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md is loaded at startup. Past that the content is paid for on disk but never read.
Rules without paths: frontmatter load unconditionally at launch and cost always-on context. Rules with paths: are cheap but are lost at compaction until a matching file is read again.
